reason_not_train: 160bp constrained output is algebraically fixed by source40bp totals; sourcezero targetpositive cannot be recovered under exact conservation. Existing shared/conditional networks show tiny cross-repeat differences. No evidence supports another architecture/loss search.
caveat: Conditional proportion error is defined only for common-positive blocks; raw errors retain every block. Effective-pixel strata are paired observed-count diagnostics, not training masks. Stratum MAE/MSE cannot be relabelled as local SSIM.
